table: Tabel nilai indeks risiko Provinsi Jawa Barat dari Tahun 2015 sampai dengan Tahun 2023; printed/PDF 101
direction_explanation: Higher official index indicates greater modeled disaster risk, not weaker capacity alone or more realized2023 disasters.
reporting_bias: Not primarily annual event-report count; depends on older model inputs, risk modelling, capacity assessment and annual assessment/revision coverage.
redundancy_risk: Contains H/V/C; exposure enters vulnerability. Do not add its hazard-specific risk scores, IKD or vulnerability/exposure components as extra independent CORE. Socioeconomic/service conceptual links remain implicit and must be disclosed, not duplicated with extra resilience proxies.
reason: KEEP, narrowly labelled modeled Disaster Pressure; complete official2023 residual-risk composite, no extra nested components. Older baselines and assessment freshness constrain interpretation, not hidden new2023 hazards.

formula: Published BNPB hazard-specific risk score combining classified hazard, vulnerability/exposure/loss components, and government capacity. H/V baseline IRBI2013 (KRB2011); capacity updated via IKD. Do not equate to overall IRBI or physical hazard intensity.
direction_explanation: Higher published score means higher modeled residual risk for this hazard. Natural direction retained.
reporting_bias: Model/baseline and district capacity-assessment coverage; not event-reporting frequency. District-specific fresh 2023 IKD assessment not established.
redundancy_risk: Hazard-specific component/alternative to overall IRBI, with repeated H/V/capacity structure; additive use beside overall IRBI double counts unless nonredundancy proven.
reason: Useful hazard-risk decomposition, not an independent CORE indicator while overall IRBI remains. Availability alone does not establish independent civic pressure.
caveats: ["Risk is not pure hazard, exposure, realized annual impact, or resilience outcome.","No normalization, inversion, sum, score or weight applied.","No zero inferred from missing rows; observed numeric zeros would remain zero.","Not directly comparable in level across different hazards.","CV of class-weighted composite points lacks a defensible ratio-scale interpretation."]
